verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit ships an official CLI that reviews local diffs before commit (coderabbit-docs-2, coderabbit-probe-3), which covers the 'local diffs' part of the story, but there is no evidence of CI-script invocation or machine-readable (e.g., JSON) output that tooling could consume. missing for 10: explicit CI-mode CLI docs, machine-readable/structured output format, exit-code or JSON schema for automation.
